name: Bedi
backstory: Bedi is a new recruit of the Cult of the Absolute who can be encountered in Act Two. He is initially found in the outskirts of the Ruined Battlefield, on a mission to escort a True Soul to Moonrise Towers.
voice_hint: half-orc barbarian (voiced by Leemore Marrett Jr.)
